integration: android/deps/build_deps.sh extracts the existing verified zstd archive into out/include/totk_xxhash.h. Only the first preamble guard defining XXH_NO_XXH3 becomes #if 0; the algorithm is unchanged. textures.c uses XXH_INLINE_ALL, so no second shared library or exported xxHash API is added.
purpose: Transient full-content texture change detection. Not used for persistent shader, cache, game-library or artifact identities.
